New York City language and nativity by county, ACS 5-year

Source: R/data.R
nyc_county_acs_language_nativity_df.Rd

Language spoken at home and place of birth / citizenship from the 2020-2024 American Community Survey 5-year release for the five New York City counties (boroughs). Sourced from ACS tables B16001 (language spoken at home) and B05002 (place of birth and citizenship). Each estimate is accompanied by its 90% margin of error, with the suffix _moe. The county-level counterpart of nyc_tract_acs_language_nativity_df. Joins to nycmaps::nyc_boros_sf via the county column, which matches nycmaps::nyc_boros$short_county_name.

Usage

nyc_county_acs_language_nativity_df

Format

A tibble with 5 rows and 21 columns:

geoid

5-character county GEOID.

county

NYC county (borough) name derived from geoid.

name

County label as returned by the Census Bureau.

lang_total

Population 5 years and over (B16001_001).

lang_english_only

Speaks English only at home (B16001_002).

lang_spanish

Speaks Spanish at home (B16001_003).

nativity_total

Total population, nativity universe (B05002_001).

native

Native-born population (B05002_002).

foreign_born

Foreign-born population (B05002_013).

naturalized

Foreign-born, naturalized US citizen (B05002_014).

not_citizen

Foreign-born, not a US citizen (B05002_021).

lang_total_moe, lang_english_only_moe, lang_spanish_moe, nativity_total_moe, native_moe, foreign_born_moe, naturalized_moe, not_citizen_moe

Margins of error for the corresponding estimates.

english_only_prop

lang_english_only / lang_total. NA when lang_total == 0.

foreign_born_prop

foreign_born / nativity_total. NA when nativity_total == 0.

Source

US Census Bureau, 2020-2024 American Community Survey 5-year estimates, tables B16001 and B05002. Retrieved via tidycensus::get_acs(). https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs
